newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize closes down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize closes down in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed down Monday after slumping under the weight of sliding international prices in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

FAS elevator maize fell$1 to $98 for delivery to the port of Buenos Aires. FAS elevator soybeans rose $2 in Rosario to $254, with international prices down but supply very hard to come by for immediate delivery. But soybeans fell in futures trading. Cash sunflower seed gained $3 to $223 for Buenos Aires delivery, with supply also very tight.
